summary: Phase C (registration import / bulk export / bulk actions) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_phasec_import_export.py — 49/49 passing twice (idempotent): template header == IMPORT_FIELDS, CSV + XLSX parse & auto-mapping, preview validation report (missing_required / invalid_email / invalid_phone / duplicate by email, phone, confirmation_number), commit with all three duplicate strategies (skip / update / new) incl. re-run-same-file behaviour and derived fields (source 'Bulk Import', generated confirmation_number + checkin_token, is_member, normalized website, Yes/True/1 opt-ins, payment coercion), export csv/xlsx/pdf content-types + all 11 segments verified against the registration list + fields=/ids=/state=/category= filters, STAFF vs non-staff-owner contact-field gating (csv/xlsx/pdf all strip Email/Phone for the non-staff owner even when explicitly requested), every bulk action with DB re-read verification, bulk_<action> audit entries, and authz 401/403/404. Frontend: full Playwright run of Portal Events -> Registrations — import wizard (template download URL, CSV upload, prefilled mapping selects, preview counts Total3/Valid2/Missing required1/Will skip1, strategy select, result panel Imported2/Failed1 + row error, new rows appear with Source 'Bulk Import'), export dialog (11 segments, 20 field checkboxes, csv/xlsx/pdf buttons, correct download URL with format/segment/fields/ids), bulk bar + confirm dialog (action, affected count, event name, email note, value selects for category/badge/payment) and all 11 bulk entries incl. client-side Print Badges and Export Selected. All Phase C test data cleaned up; evt_246d20a66b31 and evt_badgetest left Approved+published.

minor.issue: Duplicate matchers differ: preview also matches on first+last+business ('name+business'), commit does not. A row preview flags as duplicate/skip can still be inserted by commit with strategy 'skip' — misleading validation report.
Rows with an invalid phone are counted in 'valid' and are imported by commit (no phone validation there), so 'Invalid phones' in the report has no effect on the outcome.
Unknown action or invalid 'value' (e.g. update_payment value='not_a_status') returns 200 {ok:true, affected:0} instead of 400; UI then shows a green '0 updated' toast.

Only one aggregate audit entry is written with related_type='event'; nothing is written per registration, so bulk category/payment/checkin/cancel changes never show up in a registration's Activity History (GET /api/registrations/{id}/history filters related_type='registration').
Unknown segment value silently falls back to exporting everything (_segment_query .get(segment, {})) instead of 400.

PRE-EXISTING (Phase A): response is read before the fire-and-forget confirmation task runs, so it returns confirmation_sent=false even when the confirmation is sent (DB flag flips ~1s later). Causes 3 regression failures in test_phasea_registrations.py::TestPaidFlow and test_phaseb_regmgmt.py::test_manual_no_auto_confirmation_email.

delivered@resend.dev intermittently logs status 'failed' with 'Provider did not return a message id' (seen right after bulk resends — looks like provider rate limiting). Makes email-status assertions flaky; not a Phase C defect.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: the registration table forces the modal content wider than the DialogContent (which is overflow-x-hidden), so the toolbar buttons and the right-hand table columns are rendered OUTSIDE the dialog and are unreachable for a real user. Measured at 1920x1080: dialog right edge 1536 but import-btn 1658-1748, export-btn 1756-1846, add-manual-btn 1854-2042, row Actions button right 2014 — all clipped=true. Same at 1440x900. Playwright can still click them only because it scrolls programmatically. Suggested fix: add min-w-0 w-full max-w-full to the RegistrationTable root div (and to the Tabs/TabsContent wrapper) so the overflow-x-auto table wrapper shrinks to the dialog width.

issues: Console warning on every dialog: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (a11y)
Bulk confirm dialog for destructive actions (Cancel / Archive) uses the same magenta Confirm button as benign actions — no destructive styling

action_items: Fix modal overflow so Import/Export/Add Manual Registration and the row Actions/Print columns stay inside the Manage dialog (add min-w-0/w-full to the RegistrationTable root + tab content).
Align duplicate detection between import/preview and import/commit (commit is missing the name+business matcher).
Return 400 from /bulk for unknown action or invalid value instead of 200 affected:0.
Write per-registration audit entries for bulk actions so they appear in registration Activity History.
Decide what an invalid phone should do on import (currently counted but ignored by commit).

PRE-EXISTING: re-read the registration after the confirmation send (or return the computed flag) in PUT /registrations/{id}/payment so confirmation_sent is accurate — currently fails 3 Phase A/B regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2475 lines — split into routers (events, registrations, import/export, badges) per the >700-line guideline.

import/parse trusts client-supplied rows for preview/commit (rows are echoed back and re-posted); a caller can post arbitrary rows — acceptable since the endpoint is staff/owner gated, but the 2000-row parse cap is not enforced on commit, so an oversized commit payload is possible.
export_registrations loads up to 10000 registrations plus builds the whole CSV/XLSX/PDF in memory; fine for current scale, worth streaming later.
Bulk actions issue one update_one per registration inside a Python loop — use bulk_write/update_many for the non-email actions.

rca_of_the_issue: Modal clipping: DialogContent (max-w-6xl, overflow-x-hidden) lays out its children in a grid, so the RegistrationTable block takes its min-content width from the wide <table>; the sibling toolbar flex row then stretches to that width and everything past the dialog's right edge is clipped with no way for the user to scroll (overflow-x:hidden). Confirmed by getBoundingClientRect at 1920 and 1440 viewports. Payment-flag issue: PUT /registrations/{id}/payment does find_one before asyncio.create_task(send_registration_confirmation(...)), so the returned document predates the confirmation_sent update (verified with probe_payment_flag.py: response false, DB true after ~1s).
